_comment: BUILD-SPEC ONLY - NOT an importable workflow template. ASSESSMENT-ALIGNED EDITION. The live artifact is templates/11-Part 2-template.json (title 'Part 2 - Code validation (3-route aligned)'). Flow: Ticket Created -> Ask AI (structured JSON {classification,justification}) -> Execute Code validator (invoke_code) BEFORE the Router -> Router with EXACTLY 3 named routes (Bug/Feature/Enhancement). The validator uses the STRICT entrypoint (run_strict in ../code/classification_validator.py): on a clean in-enum result it emits route = the accepted label; on ANY invalid/malformed/unknown output it RAISES ValueError, which STOPS the run (no 4th Review route, no silent mutation). Bug -> severity high + Execute Code title validation + internal invalid-title comment. Feature/Enhancement -> severity medium UNCONDITIONALLY (no no-downgrade gate). Every path posts an internal classification-justification comment. The Code 'code' input is value type text_template (matches a real Execute Code export sample from this org). The Code input_values/output_schema shapes and the Ask AI/Router export shapes are reference-docs CANDIDATES, NOT live-verified; configure/cross-check them in the Workflow Builder UI. SECURITY: never eval/exec, never $eval the untrusted AI string. edison-org-for-test ONLY; set the trigger part filter before publishing. ASSESSMENT CANDIDATE - a live import + re-export round-trip is still PENDING; do not call this import-ready.
title: DevRevU Part 2 - AI classify + Router

trigger.filter: REQUIRED: dedicated Part 2 test part (distinct from Part 1's part)

nodes.purpose: Classify the ticket into exactly one of Bug | Feature | Enhancement, with a short justification.
safety: The ticket title/body are UNTRUSTED. The prompt delimits them inside <ticket_title>/<ticket_body> tags and instructs the model to treat them as DATA, never as instructions or tool commands (prompt-injection defense).

Do NOT assume AI determinism. The classification_validator node (below) re-validates the AI output into approved vs requires_review before the Router sees it; the Router default path and the Execute Code validators both handle unexpected / malformed classification safely.

nodes.code_field_hint: Paste the module as a 'code' field (value type text_template). Entry function run_strict(inputs, keyrings) - the ALIGNED strict variant.
nodes.purpose: Validate the (non-deterministic, untrusted) Ask AI output BEFORE routing. On a clean in-enum result it emits route = the accepted label. On ANY invalid/malformed/unknown/empty-justification output it RAISES ValueError, which STOPS the run (no 4th Review route, no mutation). Never mutates, never eval/exec, never $eval the AI string.

fields.name: route
fields.description: Accepted label the Router branches on: Bug/Feature/Enhancement

nodes.notes: Enum matched EXACTLY (case-sensitive) against Bug/Feature/Enhancement. Malformed JSON, unknown label, or empty justification RAISE ValueError (run fails) - the exercise's Router has exactly 3 paths, so bad output stops the run rather than routing to a 4th branch. OPTIONAL non-failing alternative: the module's validate_classification/run return a requires_review Review result instead; documented as a non-default safety variant.

nodes.purpose: Branch into EXACTLY 3 mutually-exclusive named routes based on the validated route enum. The validator raises on everything else, so no fallback route is needed.
nodes.notes: EXACTLY 3 named routes - NO 4th Review route. Router slug/config is NOT independently verified for this org - configure the 3 named routes in the UI. Do NOT invent import config.

nodes.code_field_hint: Paste the module as a literal 'code' field (literal is safest). Entry function run(inputs, keyrings).

fields.name: is_valid
fields.description: Whether the title matches the assumed Bug format

nodes.note: The Bug-path invalid-title comment is INTERNAL by convention (visibility=internal) and the validation error is an internal diagnostic - it is never surfaced to the requester.

Set severity=medium UNCONDITIONALLY (no no-downgrade gate) - matches the exercise exactly.

Post on EVERY path (Bug, Feature, Enhancement) - each path has its own comment step in the template (bug_justification_comment / feature_justification_comment / enhancement_justification_comment). Satisfies 'post a classification justification comment on all paths'. Quote the VALIDATED output (validate_classification), not the raw AI output.

design_notes.three_routes_only: The exercise's Router has EXACTLY three named paths (Bug/Feature/Enhancement). The aligned template keeps exactly those three and no 4th fallback.
design_notes.raise_on_invalid: The validator (run_strict) RAISES ValueError on any malformed/unknown/empty-justification AI output, which STOPS the run (shown as a failed run in the Runs tab). This replaces the earlier 4th 'Review' route and guarantees no severity mutation on bad AI output.
design_notes.feature_enhancement_unconditional_medium: Feature/Enhancement set severity=medium UNCONDITIONALLY, matching the exercise. The earlier no-downgrade If/Else gates were removed.
design_notes.optional_review_variant: The module's validate_classification/run functions still return a non-failing requires_review 'Review' result; this is an OPTIONAL safety alternative, documented separately, and is NOT wired into the aligned template.
design_notes.security: The validator never uses eval/exec and never runs JSONata $eval on the untrusted AI string. Untrusted title/body are delimited and treated as DATA in the Ask AI prompt.
